description_zh: 零依赖 Node 服务驱动的课堂互动课件：学生端作答（选择/判断/填空/拖拽/开放），教师机大屏实时汇总全班正确率与开放作答。适用于随堂测验、练习、概念梳理、开放讨论。改一个题库文件即可换学科。
description_en: Zero-dependency classroom interactive courseware: student answering plus teacher big-screen live aggregation of the whole class's correctness rate and open responses. Swap subjects by editing one question-bank file.
examples_zh: 帮我做个初中物理课堂互动课件

examples_en: Make a middle-school physics interactive courseware
Generate an English quiz with choice, judge and open questions
